result:
All 14 queries ran and gave plausible answers on the sample files. I haven't checked them against the expected results. Four things to know:
- **P2:** I didn't look for odd values in `qty` or `price`. I only checked the status values, which are mixed case.
- **P7:** Pipe `app.log` and `config.env` into `qlang --raw`, as the rules say. The queries themselves are the same either way.
- **P8:** The result printed with keyword keys (`:eng 5500`) rather than quoted JSON keys. I didn't convert them.
- **P11:** The totals really are 50 for u1, u2 and u4. I printed the grouped events to confirm.

P1: filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :address | coalesce {} | at :country | ne null) | groupBy ~(/address/country) * count
P2: filter ~(/status | lower | or (eq "paid") (eq "shipped")) | * (at :items | coalesce [] | * (mul /qty /price)) | flat | sum | round 2
P3: filter ~(at :dependencies | coalesce {} | count | gt 2) * /name | sort
P4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login | coalesce "unassigned") * count
P5: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * /number
P6: /data/items | filter ~(/price | ne null) | groupBy ~(/category) * (* /price | avg | round 2)
P7: lines | filter ~(contains " user=") | filter ~(split " " | /1 | upper | eq "ERROR") * (split "user=" | /1 | split " " | /0 | lower) | distinct | sort
P8: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | count | gt 0) * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | groupBy ~(/1) * (* (/2 | parseJson) | avg | round 1)
P9: lines | drop 1 * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | filter ~(/3 | take 4 | parseJson | gte 2022) | sort ~(/2 | parseJson | desc) | take 2 * /0
P10: lines | filter ~(startsWith "DB_") * (:p (split "=") | [(p | /0 | drop 3 | lower | keyword) (p | drop 1 | join "=")]) | tag ::map
P11: filter ~(/type | lower | eq "purchase") | filter ~(at :payload | coalesce {} | at :amount | ne null) | groupBy ~(/user) | entries * {:user (/0 | keyword) :total (/1 * (/payload/amount) | sum | round 2)} | sort ~([(/total | desc) /user])
P12: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","cherry","Elder","fig","FIG","apple"] * lower | groupBy * count | entries | filter ~(/1 | gte 2) | sort ~([(/1 | desc) /0]) * (:p / | p | /0 | keyword | append ":" | append (p | /1 | print)) | join ","
P13: "1.10.2, 1.2.10, 1.9.0, 0.99.99, 1.10.10, 1.10.9" | split ", " | sort ~(split "." * parseJson) | last
P14: filter ~([(at :stock | coalesce {} | at :main | coalesce 0) (at :stock | coalesce {} | at :backup | coalesce 0)] | sum | lt 10) * /sku | sort | reverse
